data-testid="richTextElement"><h1 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:22px;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:signika,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:22px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our Accommodation</span></span></span></h1></div><div id="comp-lbnhwui9" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-lbnhwui9 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h3 class="font_3 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">At Villa Pefkakia, we offer a simple and cozy accommodation in a peaceful environment overlooking the lagoon.</span></h3>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Our guesthouse is just a short walk from the famous kite spot of Agios Nikolaos, Lefkada, making it an ideal base for kitesurfers and nature lovers alike.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Each stay is a little different, as we like to adapt to the needs of our guests. Whether you come for a short getaway or a longer kitesurf trip, we&rsquo;ll help you find the best solution for your stay.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Rates start from 88 &euro; per night for two guests, green tax included.</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">If you are planning a trip to Lefkada, please contact us directly to discuss your plans.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
We&rsquo;ll be happy to propose the perfect arrangement for your stay.</span></p></div><div class="comp-k2amcutf mu5PoX" id="comp-k2amcutf" aria-disabled="false"><a data-testid="linkElement" combined) + 2 single beds | Can accommodate 3 adults or 1 couple + 2 children</span></p></div><div id="comp-mmf35nxs" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mmf35nxs wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h1 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:22px;"><span style="font-size:22px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Important Information</span></h1>

<h1 class="font_0 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:22px;"><span style="font-size:22px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​Minimum stay 5 nights</span></span></h1>

<ul class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;">
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Please note that we do not accept pets.</span></p>
</li>
<li class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Villa Pefkakia is not a kite school. We welcome kitesurfers who already have some experience, or who want to enjoy the spot on their own.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:14px;"><span style="font-size:14px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">This helps us maintain a calm and safe environment for all our guests.</span></p></div><div id="comp-mmw0hsqn" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-mmw0hsqn wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_9 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:12px;"><span class="color_43 wixui-rich-text__text">&copy; 2026 Villa Pefkakia &ndash; All rights reserved<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:12px;"><span style="font-size:12px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_43 wixui-rich-text__text">The swimming pool is private and exclusively available to guests staying on the property.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
